question: Does using GPT-4 as the teacher for Self-Instruct-style data produce better instruction-tuned LLaMA models than GPT-3.5 data?
hypothesis: GPT-4-generated instruction data gives better zero-shot alignment than data from earlier teachers (stated as the empirical result the study validates).
contributions: GPT-4 data: 52K English and Chinese instruction-following data plus GPT-4 feedback data rating outputs of three models
Instruction-tuned LLaMA models and reward models; evaluation with human HHH, GPT-4 automatic, and ROUGE-L on unnatural instructions

method.summary: The 52K Alpaca instructions are re-answered by GPT-4 (English, and ChatGPT-translated Chinese). LLaMA-7B is fully fine-tuned on each following Alpaca's schedule. GPT-4 also scores responses from GPT-4, GPT-3.5 and OPT-IML, and an OPT-1.3B reward model is trained on the pairs and used to rerank samples.
method.task: supervised instruction tuning; reward modelling on GPT-4 comparison data

datasets.name: GPT-4 English instruction data
datasets.source: Alpaca's 52K unique instructions, one gpt-4 answer each
datasets.preprocessing: Alpaca prompt template with and without input; no iterative near-duplicate removal (one-time generation)

datasets.name: GPT-4 Chinese instruction data
datasets.source: instructions translated to Chinese by ChatGPT, answered in Chinese by GPT-4

datasets.name: Comparison data
datasets.source: GPT-4 rates its own response 1-10 and rates responses of GPT-4, GPT-3.5, OPT-IML; distribution in Fig 2
datasets.preprocessing: K responses per prompt give C(K,2) pairs (y_l,y_h) with s_l<s_h

datasets.name: Unnatural Instructions GPT-4 answers
datasets.size: 68K core triplets decoded; 9K samples used in Fig 6
datasets.source: Honovich et al. 2022 core dataset (68,478 samples)

other.also: judge in automatic evaluation and comparison data

training.objective: SFT for LLaMA; reward model: min log(sigmoid(r(x,y_h)-r(x,y_l))) as printed (sign as printed)

other.schedule: We follow the training schedule in (Taori et al., 2023); no values given here

inference.decoding: GPT-4 data generation via openai.ChatCompletion, single response; for LLaMA-GPT4 eval one response (baseline) or five responses reranked by reward model
inference.samples: 1 GPT-4 answer per instruction; 1 or 5 LLaMA-GPT4 responses per question; seeds not stated

metrics.name: Human HHH pairwise preference
metrics.definition: MTurk raters choose which of two responses is more helpful/honest/harmless; 5 options merged to 3 (A, tie, B)

metrics.name: GPT-4 relative score
metrics.definition: GPT-4 rates each response 1-10 per question; sums over 80 questions (max 800) as ratio to the opponent model

metrics.name: ROUGE-L
metrics.definition: against ground truth on Unnatural Instructions, 9K samples, split by ground-truth length

eval.protocol: Single run; number of MTurk raters per item, payment and agreement not stated; no significance tests

availability.weights: model checkpoints said to be released in Conclusions

prompts.text:
Below is an instruction that describes a task. Write a response that appropriately completes the request.

### Instruction: 
 {instruction} 

 ### Response:

evidence.quote: We follow the training schedule in (Taori et al., 2023) for fair comparisons.

results.claim: Humans pick LLaMA-GPT4 over Alpaca on helpfulness far more often
results.setup: Human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk, 252 User-Oriented-Instructions, LLaMA-7B tuned on 52K GPT-4 answers (LLaMA-GPT4) vs Alpaca (7B tuned on 52K GPT-3.5 answers)
results.quote: GPT-4 is the clear winner with 54.12% of the votes. GPT-3 only wins 19.74%

results.claim: On honesty the largest share is ties and Alpaca is slightly ahead of LLaMA-GPT4
results.setup: Human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk, 252 User-Oriented-Instructions, LLaMA-7B tuned on 52K GPT-4 answers (LLaMA-GPT4) vs Alpaca (7B tuned on 52K GPT-3.5 answers)
results.note: Figure labels printed: Alpaca 31.39, LLaMA-GPT4 25.99, Tie 42.61 (honesty)
results.table: Fig 3a text labels: honesty Alpaca 31.39%, LLaMA-GPT4 25.99%, Tie 42.61%

results.claim: On harmlessness ties dominate and Alpaca is slightly ahead
results.setup: Human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk, 252 User-Oriented-Instructions, LLaMA-7B tuned on 52K GPT-4 answers (LLaMA-GPT4) vs Alpaca (7B tuned on 52K GPT-3.5 answers)
results.table: Fig 3a text labels: harmlessness Alpaca 25.43%, LLaMA-GPT4 16.48%, Tie 58.10%

results.claim: LLaMA-GPT4 vs teacher GPT-4 on helpfulness is near parity
results.setup: Human evaluation, 252 user-oriented instructions, LLaMA-GPT4 7B vs GPT-4
results.quote: GPT-4-instruction-tuned LLaMA performs similarly to the original GPT-4

results.claim: GPT-4 automatic score of LLaMA-GPT4 (7B) relative to ChatGPT
results.setup: 80 Vicuna-Instructions questions, GPT-4 scores 1-10 per response, sum over 80 (full 800); one response per question, opponent ChatGPT

results.claim: GPT-4 automatic score of LLaMA-GPT4 (7B) relative to GPT-4
results.setup: 80 Vicuna-Instructions questions, opponent GPT-4, one response per question

results.claim: Alpaca 13B relative to ChatGPT, for comparison
results.setup: Same Vicuna-80 GPT-4 evaluation as above, Alpaca (13B)

results.claim: Reward-model reranking of five samples lifts the top group over baseline decoding (vs GPT-4 opponent)
results.setup: Five responses per question ranked by OPT-1.3B reward model, top-1 group (R1) vs opponent GPT-4; baseline one response 83%
results.note: Fig 4b group bars: groups 1-5 = 87,85,85,83,83 and B 83 (vs GPT-4); 94,92,91,89,89 and B 91 vs ChatGPT. Ranking-group monotone ordering is the evidence for reward model

results.claim: Mean ROUGE-L on Unnatural Instructions: Alpaca beats LLaMA-GPT4 and GPT-4
results.setup: 9K samples of Unnatural Instructions (core 68K); Alpaca 0.39, LLaMA-GPT4 0.34, GPT4 0.37
results.quote: Alpaca outperforms the other two models

results.claim: GPT-4 output vocabulary: unique verb-noun pairs
results.setup: English outputs for the 52K Alpaca instructions; GPT-3.5 (Alpaca) has 6133

results.claim: Chinese answers: LLaMA-GPT4-CN scores relative to GPT-4 asked in Chinese
results.setup: 80 questions translated, all models answer in Chinese, opponent GPT-4; LLaMA_GPT4 (7B) 35%, Alpaca 33%

limits: Preliminary release; only 7B LLaMA and 52K examples, larger models and data left as future work
Reward model used only at decoding time, not in RL training
One-time generation without Alpaca's iterative deduplication; GPT-3.5 data has longer tail
Fine-tuning hyperparameters not stated; rely on Alpaca's schedule
Honesty and harmlessness gains not shown: ties dominate and Alpaca is slightly ahead
LLaMA-GPT4 still trails GPT-4 on the GPT-4-judged score (83%) and Alpaca scores higher mean ROUGE-L
Judge is GPT-4, the same model that produced the training data; no human-rater count or agreement reported

lineage.note: uses GPT-4 as the teacher; also source of User-Oriented-Instructions-252
Vicuna-80 benchmark and GPT-4 evaluation protocol
OPT 1.3B reward model base; one of three comparison-data models

lineage.work: A general language assistant as a laboratory for alignment
